title: Super Mario World
shortDescription: A landmark 16-bit platformer built around expansive stages, secret routes, and a dependable sense of movement.
highlights: A broad world map with optional paths and hidden exits
Responsive platforming that rewards experimentation and route planning

signals.label: GameAtlas alpha selection
signals.rationale: A high-confidence SNES starting point: its layered world map, secret exits, and movement polish demonstrate why the platform remains a useful reference point for 16-bit design.
